HOME SCIENCE MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.

21. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
